event.title: fix(ui/skills): prevent skill toggle state transfer on list mutation (#89661)
event.body:
## Summary

Fixes #89661.

When a skill toggle was flipped and the skill moved to another tab (e.g., from Disabled to Ready), the checkbox UI state was incorrectly transferred to the next skill in the list. This happened because the skill list in `renderSkills` used a plain `.map()` without keys, causing lit-html to reuse DOM nodes by position rather than by identity.

## Changes

- `ui/src/ui/views/skills.ts`: Replaced plain `.map()` with lit's `repeat` directive, using `skill.skillKey` as the unique key. This ensures each skill gets its own stable DOM node, preventing state leakage between list items.
- `ui/src/ui/views/skills.test.ts`: Added a regression test that renders two disabled skills, simulates one being enabled (removed from the disabled tab), and asserts that the remaining skill's toggle stays unchecked.

## Verification

- `pnpm test ui/src/ui/views/skills.test.ts` — all 5 tests pass (including the new regression test).

linked_issues.title: [Bug]: skill toggle incorrectly transfers UI state after interaction
linked_issues.body:
### Bug type

Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash)

### Beta release blocker

No

### Summary

When a skill toggle is flipped and the skill is removed from the current tab (Ready, Disabled, etc), the toggle remains in that status for the skill that takes its place.

See the video in the "Expected behavior" section.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Start OpenClaw 2026.6.2.
2. Open the Control dashboard and navigate to Skills.
3. Navigate to any Skills tab with skills in it (for example, Disabled).
4. Click the toggle to enable/disable the first skill in the list.

### Expected behavior

No prior observed behavior, but I think any normal would recognize this behavior as unwanted. When a skill is enabled/disabled, the next skill in the list should not be affected.

The attached video shows behavior after the fix, which I believe displays the expected behavior.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e948dfd9-2fb9-4569-a5c8-88b159e9cd51

### Actual behavior

The skill is removed from the tab as expected (for example, from Disabled to Ready). However the next skill in the list now has a toggle that appears to be enabled.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7246125f-ea45-4974-809b-41de248962e6

### OpenClaw version

2026.6.2

### Operating system

Ubuntu 24.04.4

### Install method

pnpm install

### Model

anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6

### Provider / routing chain

openclaw -> anthropic

### Additional provider/model setup details

_No response_

### Logs, screenshots, and evidence

```shell

```

### Impact and severity

Affected: all users
Severity: annoying

### Additional information

Reproducible on Chrome and Firefox.
